notes: Requirements for 'can get now'. Modelled on the remake: the original game's logic (via OoT Randomizer) with the remake's changes as documented by Clawshot (MIT) and the guides it cites; entries marked unsure are matched to a spot by description only, or not yet confirmed. Expressions use and/or/parentheses, child/adult, and Name>=N for numbers. Location keys are '<category>#<checklist number>'. Edit freely: the app re-reads this file at start.

magic_beans_planted#4.note: The soil is behind the boulder in front of Dodongo's Cavern.

heart_pieces#11.note: A child can grab it before the heat gets too much; as adult, wear the Goron Tunic. No Hookshot needed.

heart_pieces#12.needs: (child and DinsFireItem and BlastOrSmash) or (adult and Hookshot)
heart_pieces#12.note: Child: the owl at the Death Mountain summit drops you on Impa's roof, but only once you have Din's Fire. Adult: Hookshot.

heart_pieces#13.note: The Bombchu Bowling Alley opens only after King Dodongo.

heart_pieces#18.note: Child: the Boomerang. Adult: through Dampé's grave (Song of Time).

heart_pieces#23.note: The soil is behind the Dodongo's Cavern boulder, which the bracelet's bomb flower opens.

heart_pieces#30.needs: HoverBoots or (ScarecrowSong and Hookshot) or Longshot

heart_pieces#32.note: The Desert Colossus bean's planted flag isn't mapped yet, so this only checks that you own a bean.

heart_pieces#33.note: No Sun's Song in the remake. As a child the grave can only be pulled at night.

heart_pieces#34.note: Read the password on the Fairy Note by the hole as adult, then buy it as a child for 100 Rupees.

heart_pieces#35.note: Read the Fairy Note as adult first; the chest is opened as a child.

heart_pieces#36.note: The scrub sells it for 100 Rupees (the starting wallet holds 200).

gold_skulltulas#4.note: Burn the web. In the remake no Deku Tree Skulltula needs bombs, and all of them can be collected on the first visit.

gold_skulltulas#20.note: The soil is behind the boulder that the bracelet's bomb flower opens.

gold_skulltulas#37.note: Out of reach on the house wall: the Boomerang brings the token back.

gold_skulltulas#38.needs: (child and Boomerang and MetZelda) or (adult and Hookshot)

gold_skulltulas#71.needs: WaterTempleGear and ZeldasLullaby and Longshot and Explosives and Strength1

gold_skulltulas#87.needs: (adult and Longshot) or (child and Boomerang and MetZelda)

gold_skulltulas#90.note: The Desert Colossus bean's planted flag isn't mapped yet, so the bean route only checks that you own a bean.

gold_skulltulas#92.needs: (child and Boomerang and Explosives) or (adult and SpiritAdultSide)

gold_skulltulas#99.note: Kill the Skulltula in the marsh grotto as a child; as adult, break the crate for the token.

songs#3.note: Talon has to be back at the ranch first: get the Weird Egg from Malon at Hyrule Castle, let it hatch, and wake Talon there with the Cucco.

items#10.note: Zelda's Lullaby opens Darunia's door; he gives the bracelet after you play Saria's Song.

items#14.note: The Bombchu Shop opens at night, after King Dodongo.

items#19.needs: ZeldasLullaby and BlastOrSmash and DinsFireItem and AdultWallet

masks#2.note: Turn in the Keaton Mask to the Kakariko gate guard to get the Skull Mask.

masks#3.note: Turn in the Skull Mask to the Skull Kid in the Lost Woods to get the Spooky Mask.

masks#4.note: Turn in the Spooky Mask to the Graveyard boy to get the Bunny Hood.

masks#5.note: Borrow it once the Bunny Hood is sold; the running man only buys the Bunny Hood after all three child dungeon bosses are beaten (all three Spiritual Stones).

masks#6.note: Sell the Keaton Mask to the guard at Kakariko's gate; the shop lends the Skull Mask after.

masks#7.note: Sell the Skull Mask to the Skull Kid in the Lost Woods; the shop lends the Spooky Mask after.

masks#8.note: Sell the Spooky Mask to the boy in the Graveyard; the shop lends the Bunny Hood after.

masks#9.note: Sell the Bunny Hood to the running man in Hyrule Field; only after all three Spiritual Stones, and the shop lends the Mask of Truth after.

bottles#1.note: Available as soon as you reach Castle Town; no other requirement.

bottles#2.note: The Cucco Lady gives the bottle once all seven Cuccos are back in her pen.

bottles#3.note: Talon has to be back at the ranch first: get the Weird Egg from Malon at Hyrule Castle, let it hatch, and wake Talon there with the Cucco.

bottles#4.note: The letter has to be shown to King Zora first (in Zora's Domain).

bottles#5.needs: Bottle and Epona and Bow and FivePoesSold
bottles#5.note: The Poe Collector gives the bottle once five Big Poes are sold (500 points).

bottles#6.note: Show Ruto's Letter to King Zora; he moves his throne to the Fountain.

bottles#7.note: Bring all seven Cuccos back to the pen at the Cucco Lady's house.

bottles#8.note: Sell five Big Poes to the Poe Collector (500 points); each Poe's soul is bottled and sold in the same action.

great_fairies#2.note: Appears only once you have Din's Fire. 50 Rupees.

great_fairies#3.note: Appears only once you have Din's Fire. 100 Rupees.

great_fairies#4.note: Appears only once you have Din's Fire. 200 Rupees.

great_fairies#5.needs: ZeldasLullaby and BlastOrSmash and DinsFireItem and AdultWallet
great_fairies#5.note: Appears only once you have Din's Fire. 300 Rupees: more than the starting wallet holds.

great_fairies#6.needs: ZeldasLullaby and Strength3 and DinsFireItem and AdultWallet
great_fairies#6.note: Appears only once you have Din's Fire. 500 Rupees: needs the Adult's Wallet.

dungeon_items#16.needs: Strength2 and Explosives and ZeldasLullaby and (Hookshot or Longshot)
